mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the result showed it attaching to haemoglobin and being released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma was fairly predictable, and the result mostly confirmed what the item names already suggested.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; the pairings followed the goals and picture descriptions, though the compatible options supplied the hints.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how these blood components work in the body. The oxygen delivery explanation was interesting, although some assembly steps were predictable.
